bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties
bookInfo.author: Xue Juzheng et al.

title.zh: 卷一百四十八 志10: 選舉志
title.raw: 卷一百四十八 志10: 選舉志 Volume 148: Treatises 10 Selection of Officials

sentences.zh: 選舉誌

translations.literal: Treatise on Selection and Examination
translations.idiomatic: Treatise on Selection and Examination

sentences.zh: 按《唐典》，凡選授之制，天官卿掌之，所以正權衡而進賢能也；

translations.literal: According to the Tang Code, all regulations for appointment and selection were administered by the Minister of the Office of Heaven, in order to balance the scales and advance the worthy and capable;
translations.idiomatic: According to the Tang Code, all rules governing appointment and selection fell to the Minister of the Office of Heaven, whose charge was to weigh merit fairly and advance the worthy and capable;

sentences.zh: 凡貢舉之政，春官卿掌之，所以核文行而第雋秀也。

translations.literal: all policies for tribute examinations were administered by the Minister of the Office of Spring, in order to verify literary conduct and rank the outstanding.
translations.idiomatic: all policies for the tribute examinations belonged to the Minister of the Office of Spring, who verified candidates' literary conduct and ranked the outstanding among them.

sentences.zh: 洎梁氏以降，皆奉而行之，縱或小有厘革，亦不出其軌轍。

translations.literal: From the Liang dynasty onward, all followed and implemented these rules; even when there were minor revisions, they did not depart from this track.
translations.idiomatic: From the Liang dynasty onward, each regime followed and enforced these rules; even minor revisions never departed from the same basic framework.

sentences.zh: 今采其事。

translations.literal: Now we collect these matters.
translations.idiomatic: Here we gather the relevant records.

sentences.zh: 備紀於後，以誌五代審官取士之方也。

translations.literal: To record them fully below, in order to document the methods by which the Five Dynasties examined officials and recruited scholars.
translations.idiomatic: They are set down below to record how the Five Dynasties examined officials and recruited talent.

sentences.zh: 梁開平元年七月，敕：「近年舉人，當秋薦之時，不親試者號為『拔解』，今後宜止絕。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Kaiping of Liang, an edict: "In recent years when candidates were recommended in autumn, those who did not take the trial examination were called 'pulling the recommendation'; from now on this should be stopped."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Kaiping 1 of Liang, an edict declared: "In recent years, candidates recommended in autumn who skipped the trial examination were called 'pulling the recommendation'; this practice must cease."

sentences.zh: 四月，兵部尚書、權知貢舉姚洎奏：「近代設文科、選胄子，所以綱維名教，崇樹邦本也。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Yao Ji, Minister of War and acting supervisor of the examinations, memorialized: "In recent times the literary examination and selection of imperial scions were established to maintain the teachings and exalt the foundation of the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Yao Ji, Minister of War and acting supervisor of the examinations, submitted: "The literary examination and selection of imperial scions were established in recent times to uphold the teachings and strengthen the foundation of the state.

sentences.zh: 今在朝公卿親屬、將相子孫，有文行可取者，請許所在州府薦送，以廣疏材之路。」

translations.literal: Now among the kin of officials at court and the descendants of generals and ministers, any with literary conduct worth selecting—please allow the prefectures and districts where they reside to recommend and send them forward, to broaden the path for discovering talent."
translations.idiomatic: Among the kin of court officials and the descendants of generals and ministers, any who show genuine literary merit should be allowed to be recommended and sent forward by their local prefecture or district, so that the path for discovering talent may be widened."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 〈（《文獻通考》：唐時知貢舉皆用禮部侍郎，梁開平中，始命兵部侍郎楊涉權知貢舉。）〉

translations.literal: (Wenxian Tongkao: In Tang times supervisors of the examinations were always Vice Ministers of Rites; in Liang Kaiping, for the first time Vice Minister of War Yang She was appointed acting supervisor of the examinations.))〉
translations.idiomatic: (Wenxian Tongkao notes: In Tang, supervisors of the examinations were always Vice Ministers of Rites; under Liang in the Kaiping era, Vice Minister of War Yang She was for the first time appointed acting supervisor.))〉

sentences.zh: 唐同光二年十月，中書奏，請停舉選一年。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year of Tongguang of Tang, the Secretariat memorialized requesting cessation of examinations and selections for one year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Tongguang 2 of Tang, the Secretariat asked to suspend examinations and selections for one year.

sentences.zh: 敕：「舉、選二門，國朝之重事，但要精確，難議權停，宜準常例處分。」

translations.literal: Edict: "The examination and selection gates are weighty matters of the dynasty; we need only precision—hard to discuss temporarily stopping; handle according to the usual rules."
translations.idiomatic: An edict replied: "Examinations and selections are weighty affairs of the dynasty and demand precision; a temporary halt is hard to justify. Handle them according to the usual rules."

sentences.zh: 天成元年八月，敕：「應三京、諸道，今年貢舉人，可依常年取解，仍命隨處量事，津送赴闕。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of Tiancheng 1, an edict: "For the Three Capitals and all circuits, this year's tribute examination candidates may obtain credentials according to the usual annual practice; still order local offices to provide travel assistance as circumstances require and escort them to the capital."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Tiancheng 1, an edict declared: "For the Three Capitals and all circuits, this year's tribute examination candidates may obtain credentials according to the usual annual practice; local offices are to provide travel assistance as circumstances require and escort them to the capital."

sentences.zh: 五年二月九日，敕：「近年文士，輕視格條，就試時疏於帖經，登第後恥於赴選。宜絕躁求之路，別開獎勸之門。其進士科已及第者，計選數年滿日，許令就中書陳狀，於都堂前各試本業詩賦判文。其中才藝灼然可取者，便與除官；如或事業不甚精者，自許準添選。」

translations.literal: On the ninth day of the second month of the fifth year, an edict: "In recent years literati have looked down on standard regulations, been lax in classic paste at examination time, and after passing been ashamed to attend selection. We should cut off the path of rash pursuit and open a separate gate of encouragement. For those who have already passed the jinshi examination, when their selection-cycle years are complete, permit them to petition the Secretariat and each take an examination of their profession—poetry, fu, and judgment texts—before the Hall of the Capital. Those whose talent and skill are clearly worth selecting shall at once receive appointment; if achievement is not very refined, they may still receive an added selection cycle."
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day of the second month of Tiancheng 5, an edict declared: "In recent years literati have looked down on standard regulations, been lax in classic paste at examination time, and after passing been ashamed to attend selection. We should cut off the path of rash pursuit and open a separate gate of encouragement. For jinshi degree-holders who have already passed, when their selection-cycle years are complete, permit them to petition the Secretariat and each take an examination in their profession—poetry, fu, and judgment texts—before the Hall of the Capital. Those whose talent and skill are clearly worth selecting shall at once receive appointment; if achievement is not very refined, they may still receive an added selection cycle."

sentences.zh: 晉天福三年三月，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎、權知貢舉崔棁奏：「臣謬蒙眷渥，叨掌文衡，實憂庸懦之材，不副搜羅之旨，敢不揣摩頑鈍，杜絕阿私，上則顯陛下求賢，次則使平人得路。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Tianfu of Jin, Cui Zhuang, Academician Expositor-in-Chief, Vice Minister of War, and acting supervisor of the examinations, memorialized: "Your servant has wrongly received favor and presumptuously holds the literary scales; I truly fear mediocre and timid talent will not meet the aim of searching and gathering; how dare I not scrutinize the dull and obstruct favoritism—first to display Your Majesty's seeking of the worthy, next to let ordinary men gain a path.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tianfu 3 of Jin, Cui Zhuo, Academician Expositor-in-Chief, Vice Minister of War, and acting supervisor of the examinations, wrote: "I have been favored beyond my deserts and now hold the literary scales in my hands. I fear that mediocre talent will fail Your Majesty's purpose of gathering the worthy, and I dare not fail to scrutinize the dull and shut out favoritism—first to show that Your Majesty truly seeks talent, and second so that ordinary men may still find a way forward.

sentences.zh: 但以今年就舉，比常歲倍多，科目之中，兇豪甚眾。

translations.literal: But this year's candidates sitting the examination are more than double the usual year, and among the examination categories fierce and overbearing men are very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Yet this year's examinees are more than double the usual number, and among them are many violent and overbearing men.

sentences.zh: 每駁榜出後，則時有喧張，不自省循，但言屈塞，互相朋扇，各出言詞，或云主司不公，或云試官受賂，實慮上達聖聽，微臣無以自明，晝省夜思，臨深履薄。

translations.literal: Whenever the rejection list is posted afterward, there is at once clamor; they do not examine themselves but only say they were blocked unfairly, mutually inciting factions, each putting forth words—some saying the chief examiner was unjust, some saying the testing officials took bribes; I truly fear this will reach the sacred ear, and your humble servant has no way to clarify himself—reflecting by day, thinking by night, standing at the edge of an abyss, treading on thin ice.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the rejection list is posted, uproar follows at once. The failed candidates do not reflect on themselves but claim they were unfairly blocked; they incite one another and accuse the chief examiner of bias or the testing officials of taking bribes. I fear these charges will reach Your Majesty's ear, and I have no way to clear myself—by day I brood, by night I worry, as if standing at a cliff's edge on thin ice.

sentences.zh: 今臣欲請令舉人落第之後，或不甘心，任自投狀披陳，卻請所試，與疏義對證，兼令其日一甲同共校量，若獨委試官，恐未息詞理。

translations.literal: Now your servant wishes to request that after candidates fail, if they are not reconciled, they be allowed to submit a petition stating their case, and then request their examination papers to be compared against the explanatory commentary; moreover let the entire cohort of that day jointly review and measure together—if this is entrusted only to the testing officials, I fear the disputes will not cease.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore ask that any candidate who fails and refuses to accept the result be allowed to file a petition, have his examination papers compared with the official commentary, and have the whole cohort of that day review the case together. If review is left to the testing officials alone, I fear the quarrels will never end.

sentences.zh: 儻是實負抑屈，則所司固難逭憲章；

translations.literal: If they were truly wronged and suppressed, then the responsible office naturally cannot escape the statutes;
translations.idiomatic: If a candidate was truly wronged, the responsible office cannot escape punishment under the statutes;

sentences.zh: 如其妄有陳論，則舉人乞痛加懲斷。

translations.literal: if they recklessly make false statements, then the candidate begs for severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: but if he lodges a false complaint, let the candidate be severely punished.

sentences.zh: 冀此際免虛遭謗議，亦將來可久遠施行。

translations.literal: I hope that for the present I may avoid suffering slander in vain, and that in the future this may be implemented for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: I hope thereby to escape groundless slander for now and to establish a rule that may endure.

sentences.zh: 儻蒙聖造允俞，伏乞降敕處分。」

translations.literal: If I may receive the sage creation's approval, I humbly beg an edict be issued for disposition."
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty approves, I humbly ask that an edict be issued to put this into effect."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 天福五年三月，詔：「及第舉人與主司選勝筵宴，及中書舍人靸鞋接見舉人，兼兵部、禮部引人過堂之日，幕次酒食會客，悉宜廢之。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year of Tianfu, an edict: "Banquets where successful candidates and the chief examiner choose the victor, where Secretariat Drafters in soft shoes receive candidates, and wine and food in the tent for guests on the days when the Ministries of War and Rites lead candidates through the hall—all should be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tianfu 5, an edict ordered the abolition of victory banquets held by successful candidates and the chief examiner, of Secretariat drafters receiving candidates in informal dress, and of tent-side feasts on the days when the Ministries of War and Rites led candidates through the examination hall."

sentences.zh: 四月，禮部侍郎張允奏曰：「明君側席，雖切旁求；

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Zhang Yun, Vice Minister of Rites, memorialized: "An enlightened ruler sits sideways [in eager attention], though keen in seeking from the side;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zhang Yun, Vice Minister of Rites, wrote: "An enlightened ruler may sit alert and search widely for talent;

sentences.zh: 貢士觀光，豈宜濫進。

translations.literal: tribute scholars coming to observe the splendor—how should they be allowed to advance indiscriminately?
translations.idiomatic: yet candidates coming to court should not be admitted indiscriminately.

sentences.zh: 竊窺前代，未設諸科，始以明經，俾升高第。

translations.literal: I have secretly observed earlier ages: they did not establish the various categories; they began with the Classics examination to enable advancement to higher ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back at earlier ages, the state did not yet maintain so many examination categories; it began with the Classics examination to raise men to higher office.

sentences.zh: 自有《九經》、《五經》之後，及《三禮》、《三傳》已來，孝廉之科，遂因循而不廢，搢紳之士，亦緘默而無言，以至相承，未能改作。

translations.literal: Since there were the Nine Classics and Five Classics, and since the Three Rites and Three Commentaries, the Filial and Incorrupt category was thus carried on without abolition; gentry scholars also kept silent without speaking—down to successive inheritance, unable to reform.
translations.idiomatic: After the Nine Classics, Five Classics, Three Rites, and Three Commentaries were established, the Filial and Incorrupt category was simply carried on without abolition, and the gentry kept silent until the practice hardened into custom and could no longer be changed.

sentences.zh: 每歲明經一科，少至五百以上，多及一千有餘，舉人如是繁多，試官豈能精當？

translations.literal: Each year the Classics examination alone had no fewer than five hundred, often more than a thousand; with candidates so numerous, how could the testing officials be precise and correct?
translations.idiomatic: Each year the Classics examination alone drew at least five hundred candidates and often more than a thousand. With so many examinees, how could the testing officials judge them with precision?

sentences.zh: 況此等多不究義，惟攻帖書，文理既不甚通，名第豈可妄與！

translations.literal: Moreover most of these do not investigate meaning but only attack the paste-book [memorized passages]; since literary principle is not very clear, how can ranks and degrees be rashly granted!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, most of them do not study meaning but only drill memorized passages; their literary grasp is shallow, and ranks must not be granted rashly!

sentences.zh: 且常年登科者不少，相次赴選者甚多，州縣之間，必無遣闕，輦轂之下，須有稽留，怨嗟自此而興，謗讟因茲而起。

translations.literal: Moreover each year many pass the examinations, and very many in succession go to selection; among prefectures and districts there must be no vacancies, but under the capital wheels there must be delays—resentment rises from this, slander arises thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Every year many pass the examinations and many more queue for appointment; the provinces may have no vacancies, yet under the capital appointments pile up, breeding resentment and slander.

sentences.zh: 但今廣場大啟，諸科並存，明經者悉包於《九經》、《五經》之中，無出於《三禮》、《三傳》之內，若夫厘革，恐未便宜，其明經一科，伏請停廢。」

translations.literal: But now the broad field is greatly opened and all categories coexist; Classics candidates are all contained within the Nine Classics and Five Classics, none outside the Three Rites and Three Commentaries—if we were to revise, I fear it would not be convenient; the Classics examination category alone, I humbly beg, be stopped and abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the examination field is broad and many categories coexist, Classics candidates are already covered by the Nine Classics, Five Classics, Three Rites, and Three Commentaries; further revision may be inconvenient. I humbly ask that the Classics examination alone be abolished."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「國家懸科待士，貴務搜揚；

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "The state suspends categories awaiting scholars, valuing the task of searching and raising;
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "The state maintains examinations to recruit scholars and values discovering talent;

sentences.zh: 責實求才，須除訛濫。

translations.literal: demanding reality in seeking talent, it must remove false and excessive [candidates].
translations.idiomatic: but in seeking real ability it must eliminate fraud and excess.

sentences.zh: 童子每當就試，止在念書，背經則雖似精詳，對卷則不能讀誦。

translations.literal: Youth candidates whenever they sit the examination only recite books; reciting the classics may seem meticulous, but facing the scroll they cannot read and chant.
translations.idiomatic: Youth candidates, when examined, merely memorize texts; they may recite classics with apparent precision yet cannot read the scroll aloud when tested.

sentences.zh: 及名成貢部，身返故鄉，但克日以取官，更無心而習業，濫蠲徭役，虛占官名，其童子一科，亦請停廢。」

translations.literal: When their names are made at the tribute department and they return to their home districts, they only fix a day to take office, no longer having heart to study their profession, recklessly exempted from corvée, vainly occupying office names—the Youth category too, I beg, be stopped and abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Once they pass and return home, they fix a date to take office and study no further, enjoying corvée exemptions while occupying offices in name only. I ask that the Youth examination also be abolished."

sentences.zh: 敕明經、童子、宏詞、拔萃、明算、道舉、百篇等科並停。

translations.literal: An edict stopped the Classics, Youth, Hongci, Bacui, Ming suan, Dao ju, Bai pian, and other categories together.
translations.idiomatic: An edict suspended the Classics, Youth, Hongci, Bacui, Mathematics, Daoist recommendation, Hundred Pieces, and related examinations.

sentences.zh: 天福七年五月，敕：「應諸色進策人等，皆抱材能，方來投獻，宜加明試，俾盡臧謀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year of Tianfu, an edict: "All persons submitting policy memorials of various sorts, bearing talent and ability, have just come to offer them; they should receive clear testing so that their good counsel may be fully displayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Tianfu 7, an edict declared: "All persons submitting policy memorials of various sorts, bearing talent and ability, have just come to offer them; they should receive clear testing so that their good counsel may be fully displayed.

sentences.zh: 起今後應進策條，中書奏覆，敕下，其進策人委門下省試策三道，仍定上、中、下三等。

translations.literal: From now on, for policy items submitted, after the Secretariat memorializes for reply and the edict is issued, the policy submitter shall be entrusted to the Gate Department to test three policy questions, still fixing upper, middle, and lower thirds.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, after the Secretariat reviews a submitted policy item and an edict is issued, the submitter shall take three policy examinations at the Gate Department, graded upper, middle, or lower.

sentences.zh: 如是元進策內有施行者，其所試策或上或中者，委門下省給與減選，或出身優牒合格。

translations.literal: If within the originally submitted policy there were items implemented, and their tested policy is upper or middle, entrust the Gate Department to grant reduced selection cycles or qualification by superior initial credential.
translations.idiomatic: If items in the original submission were adopted and the examination is graded upper or middle, the Gate Department shall grant a reduced selection cycle or a superior qualification certificate.

sentences.zh: 參選日，其試策上者，委銓司超壹資註擬；

translations.literal: On the day of entering selection, if the tested policy is upper, entrust the Selection Office to register appointment one rank above qualification;
translations.idiomatic: On entering selection, if the examination is upper, the Selection Office shall register the appointee one rank above qualification;

sentences.zh: 其試策中者，委銓司依資註擬。

translations.literal: if the tested policy is middle, entrust the Selection Office to register according to qualification.
translations.idiomatic: if middle, the Selection Office shall register according to qualification.

sentences.zh: 如是所試策或上或中，元進策條並不施行；

translations.literal: If the tested policy is upper or middle but none of the originally submitted policy items were implemented;
translations.idiomatic: If the examination is upper or middle but none of the original policy items were adopted;

sentences.zh: 所試策下，元進策條內有施行者，其本官並仰量與恩賜發遣。

translations.literal: if the tested policy is lower but within the originally submitted policy items some were implemented, both their original office and an appropriate measure of grace-gift dismissal are ordered.
translations.idiomatic: if the examination is lower but some original items were adopted, they shall retain their current office and receive an appropriate reward before dismissal.

sentences.zh: 若或所試策下，所進策條並不施行，便仰曉示發遣，不得再有投進。

translations.literal: If the tested policy is lower and none of the submitted policy items were implemented, then they are to be informed and dismissed, and may not submit again.
translations.idiomatic: If the examination is lower and no submitted item was adopted, they shall be informed and dismissed and may not submit again.

sentences.zh: 餘並準前後敕文處分。」

translations.literal: The rest all follow previous and subsequent edict texts for disposition."
translations.idiomatic: All other cases shall follow previous edicts."

sentences.zh: 開運元年八月，詔曰：「明經、童子之科，前代所設，蓋期取士，良謂通規。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Kaiyun, an edict said: "The Classics and Youth categories were established by earlier ages, intending to recruit scholars—a sound and customary rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Kaiyun 1, an edict declared: "The Classics and Youth examinations were established by earlier dynasties to recruit scholars and formed a sound customary rule.

sentences.zh: 爰自近年，暫從停廢，損益之機未見，牢籠之義全虧。

translations.literal: From recent years they were temporarily stopped and abolished; the mechanism of gain and loss has not been seen, and the meaning of encompassing [talent] is wholly lost.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years they were temporarily suspended before the gains and losses could be judged, and the purpose of gathering talent was lost.

sentences.zh: 將闡斯文，宜依舊貫，庶臻至理，用廣旁求。

translations.literal: To unfold this culture, we should follow the old practice, hoping to reach utmost principle and thereby broaden lateral seeking.
translations.idiomatic: To advance learning, the old practice should be restored so that principle may be attained and the search for talent broadened.

sentences.zh: 其明經、童子二科，今後復置。」

translations.literal: The Classics and Youth two categories are from now on to be restored."
translations.idiomatic: The Classics and Youth examinations are hereby restored."

sentences.zh: 十一月，工部尚書、權知貢舉竇貞固奏：「進士考試雜文及與諸科舉人入策，歷代已來，皆以三條燭盡為限，長興二年，改令晝試。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Dou Zhengu, Minister of Works and acting supervisor of the examinations, memorialized: "For jinshi literary examinations and policy tests with candidates of other categories, successive dynasties set the limit at three candles; in Changxing 2 this was changed to daytime testing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Dou Zhengu, Minister of Works and acting supervisor of the examinations, wrote: "For jinshi literary examinations and policy tests with candidates of other categories, successive dynasties set the limit at three candles; in Changxing 2 this was changed to daytime testing.

sentences.zh: 伏以懸科取士，有國常規，沿革之道雖殊，公共之情難失。

translations.literal: I humbly consider that suspending categories to recruit scholars is a constant rule of the state; though the path of continuity and change differs, the shared public sentiment is hard to lose.
translations.idiomatic: Examinations to recruit scholars are a constant state institution; though customs change over time, the public expectation behind them should not be cast aside.

sentences.zh: 若使就試兩廊之下，揮亳短景之中，視晷刻而惟畏稽遲，演詞藻而難求妍麗，未見觀光之美，但同款答之由，既非師古之規，恐失取人之道。

translations.literal: If they take the examination under the two corridors, wielding the brush in the short daylight, watching the sundial and only fearing delay, developing literary ornament yet hard to seek beauty—one does not see the beauty of observing splendor but only the reason for perfunctory answers; this is neither following antiquity's rule nor, I fear, the way of selecting men.
translations.idiomatic: Testing candidates in the corridors by daylight, they watch the clock in fear of delay and cannot polish their prose; one sees perfunctory answers, not brilliance. This follows neither ancient practice nor, I fear, the proper way to choose talent.

sentences.zh: 今欲考試之時，準舊例以三條燭為限。

translations.literal: Now at the time of examination we wish to follow the old precedent and set the limit at three candles.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that examinations again follow the old rule of three candles.

sentences.zh: 其進士並諸色舉貢人等，有懷藏書冊入院者，舊例扶出，不令就試，近年以來，雖見懷藏，多是容縱。

translations.literal: As for jinshi and candidates of various tribute categories who enter the hall concealing books, the old rule was to support them out and not allow testing; in recent years, though concealment is seen, mostly they are indulged.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi and other candidates who enter with concealed books were once escorted out and barred from testing; in recent years such cases have usually been tolerated.

sentences.zh: 今欲振舉弛紊，明辨臧否，冀在必行，庶為定式。」

translations.literal: Now we wish to rouse what has grown lax and disorderly, clearly distinguish right from wrong, hoping it will be strictly enforced and may become a fixed form."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that lax enforcement be corrected, right and wrong clearly distinguished, and the old rules strictly restored as fixed practice."

sentences.zh: 漢乾祐二年，刑部侍郎邊歸讜上言：「臣竊見每年貢舉人數甚眾，動引五舉、六舉，多至二千、三千，既事業不精，即人文何取。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianyou of Han, Bian Guidan, Vice Minister of Punishments, submitted: "Your servant has observed that each year tribute examination candidates are very numerous, often citing five or six attempts, often reaching two or three thousand; since their achievement is not refined, what literary quality is to be taken?
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyou 2 of Han, Bian Guidan, Vice Minister of Punishments, wrote: "Each year the tribute examinations draw huge numbers of candidates, many with five or six attempts and totals of two or three thousand. If their learning is shallow, what literary merit can be found in them?

sentences.zh: 請敕三京、鄴都、諸道州府長官，合發諸色貢舉人文解者，並須精加考校，事業精研，即得解送，不得濫有舉送，冀塞濫進之門，開興能之路。」

translations.literal: I beg an edict to the chiefs of the Three Capitals, Yedu, and all circuit prefectures and districts: all who should send candidates of various tribute categories with literary credentials must carefully examine them; only if achievement is refined may they be credentialed and sent—there must be no reckless sending, hoping to block the gate of reckless advancement and open the path of raising the capable."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that chiefs of the Three Capitals, Yedu, and all circuits examine every candidate carefully and send forward only those of real attainment, so that the gate to reckless advancement may be closed and the path for the capable opened."

sentences.zh: 敕從之。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved.

sentences.zh: 其間條奏未盡處，下貢院錄天福五年四月二十七日敕文，告諭天下，依元敕條件施行，如有固違，其隨處考試官員，當準敕條處分。

translations.literal: Where the memorialized items above were not complete, the examination yard was sent the edict text of the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month of the fifth year of Tianfu, announced to all under Heaven, to implement according to the original edict conditions; if anyone stubbornly violates, the testing officials wherever they are shall be handled according to the edict articles.
translations.idiomatic: On points not fully covered above, the examination yard was sent the edict of Tianfu 5, fourth month, day 27, to announce throughout the realm; local testing officials who stubbornly violate it shall be punished under the edict.

sentences.zh: 周廣順二年二月，禮部侍郎趙上交奏：「貢院諸科，今欲不試泛義，其口義五十道，改試墨義十道。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Guangshun of Zhou, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Rites, memorialized: "For all categories in the examination yard, we now wish not to test general meaning; the fifty oral-meaning questions are changed to ten ink-meaning questions."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangshun 2 of Zhou, Zhao Shangjiao, Vice Minister of Rites, asked that all examination categories drop general-meaning tests and replace fifty oral questions with ten written ones.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，趙上交奏：「進士元試詩賦各一首，帖經二十帖、對義五通，今欲罷帖經、對義，別試雜文二首、試策一道。」

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, Zhao Shangjiao memorialized: "Jinshi originally tested one each of poetry and fu, twenty classic paste questions, and five meaning responses; now we wish to abolish paste classics and meaning responses and separately test two miscellaneous writings and one policy question."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 3, Zhao Shangjiao asked that jinshi candidates no longer take classic paste and meaning-response tests but instead submit two literary pieces and one policy essay."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 其年八月，刑部侍郎、權知貢舉徐臺符奏：「請別試雜文外，其帖經、墨義，仍依元格。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year, Xu Taifu, Vice Minister of Punishments and acting supervisor of the examinations, memorialized: "Apart from separately testing miscellaneous writings, paste classics and ink meaning should still follow the original standard."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year, Xu Taifu, Vice Minister of Punishments and acting supervisor of the examinations, asked that aside from the new literary tests, paste classics and ink meaning remain under the original rules."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 顯德二年三月，禮部侍郎竇儀奏：「請諸科舉人，若合解不解、不合解而解者，監試官為首罪，勒停見任，舉送長官，奏聞取裁。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Xiande, Dou Yi, Vice Minister of Rites, memorialized: "For candidates of all categories, if those who should be credentialed are not or those who should not are, the supervising testing official bears primary guilt, is ordered to cease current office, and the recommending chief is memorialized for decision.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Xiande 2, Dou Yi, Vice Minister of Rites, memorialized: "For candidates of all categories, if those who should be credentialed are not or those who should not are, the supervising testing official bears primary guilt, is ordered to cease current office, and the recommending chief is memorialized for decision.

sentences.zh: 監試官如受賂，及今後進士，如有倩人述作文字應舉者，許人言告，送本處色役，永不進仕。」

translations.literal: If supervising testing officials take bribes, and from now on jinshi who have others compose writings to sit the examination—allow people to report by word, send them to local corvée service of the lowest sort, never to enter office."
translations.idiomatic: If supervising examiners take bribes, or if any future jinshi candidate has another compose his examination papers, informants may report them; offenders shall be sent to local corvée service and barred forever from office."

sentences.zh: 唐同光四年三月，中書門下奏議：「左拾遺王松、吏部員外郎李慎儀上疏，以諸道州縣，皆是攝官，誅剝生靈，漸不存濟。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Tongguang of Tang, the Secretariat and Chancellery submitted for deliberation: "Left Remonstrance Councillor Wang Song and Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Li Shenyi submitted a memorial that in all circuits' prefectures and districts, all are acting officials who extort the people, gradually unable to survive.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tongguang 4 of Tang, the Secretariat reported: "Left Remonstrance Councillor Wang Song and Vice Director of Personnel Li Shenyi wrote that circuit prefectures and districts are filled with acting officials who extort the people until livelihoods collapse.

sentences.zh: 比者郭崇韜在中書日，未詳本朝故事，妄被閑人獻疑，點檢選曹，曲生異議，或告赤欠少，一事闕違，保內一人不來，五保即須並廢，文書一紙有誤，數任皆不勘詳。

translations.literal: Recently when Guo Chongtao was in the Secretariat, not understanding this dynasty's precedents, he was rashly led by idle men to raise doubts, inspecting the selection bureau and perversely generating divergent opinions—if a household register was short, one matter lacked compliance, one person in the mutual-guarantee group did not come, the whole five-household group must be abolished; one sheet of document had an error, several terms of office were all not examined in detail.
translations.idiomatic: When Guo Chongtao served in the Secretariat, ignorant of court precedent, idle advisers led him to scrutinize the Selection Bureau with perverse strictness: a short household register, one lapse, or one missing guarantor could void an entire five-household group; one document error could invalidate several terms of service.

sentences.zh: 其年選人及行事官一千二百五十餘員，得官者才及數十，皆以渝濫為名，盡被焚毀棄逐，或斃踣於旅店，或號哭於道途。

translations.literal: That year candidates for selection and traveling officials numbered more than 1,250; those who received office barely reached several tens—all were named as exceeding or excessive and were entirely burned, destroyed, and driven off; some collapsed dead at inns, some wailed on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: That year more than 1,250 candidates and traveling officials sought appointment, yet only a few dozen received office; the rest were branded as fraudulent, their credentials destroyed, and they were driven away—some dying at inns, others wailing along the roads.

sentences.zh: 以至二年已來，選人不敢赴集，銓曹無人可註，中書無人可除，去年闕近二千，授官不及六十。

translations.literal: So that for two years candidates have not dared to attend assembly, the selection bureau has no one to register, the Secretariat has no one to appoint; last year vacancies neared two thousand, offices granted did not reach sixty.
translations.idiomatic: For two years candidates dared not come to assembly; the Selection Bureau had no one to register and the Secretariat no one to appoint. Last year nearly two thousand posts stood vacant while fewer than sixty appointments were made.

sentences.zh: 伏請特降敕文，宣布遐邇，明往年制置，不自於宸衷，此日焦勞，特頒於睿澤。

translations.literal: I humbly beg a special edict be issued, announced far and near, making clear that last year's arrangements did not come from the imperial heart, and that today's anxious toil specially bestows sagely grace.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly ask that a special edict announce to the realm that last year's measures did not come from Your Majesty's heart and that today's gracious labor now offers renewed imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 望以中書條件及王松等所論事節，委銓司點檢，務在酌中，以為定制。」

translations.literal: I hope the Secretariat conditions and the matters Wang Song and others discussed may be entrusted to the selection office for inspection, striving to strike the mean and become fixed regulations."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Secretariat's conditions and the points raised by Wang Song and others be entrusted to the Selection Office for review, with moderation as the fixed rule."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 時議者以銓註之弊，非止一朝，搢紳之家，自無甄別，或有伯叔告赤，鬻於同姓之家，隨賂改更，因亂昭穆，至有季父伯舅反拜侄甥者。

translations.literal: Commentators of the time held that the abuses of selection registration were not limited to one court; gentry families themselves made no distinctions—some sold uncles' household registers to families of the same surname, changing them with bribes and thereby confusing senior and junior lines, even to the point of younger uncles and elder maternal uncles reverently bowing to nephews and maternal nephews.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporaries held that abuses in selection registration were longstanding: gentry families made no distinctions, selling uncles' household registers to kinsmen of the same surname and altering them by bribe until lineages were confused—even to the point of uncles bowing to nephews.

sentences.zh: 郭崇韜疾惡太深，奏請厘革，豆盧革、韋說僶俛贊成。

translations.literal: Guo Chongtao's hatred of evil ran too deep; he memorialized requesting revision, and Doulu Ge and Wei Yue bowed and complied in approval.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao's zeal against corruption ran too deep; he memorialized for reform, and Doulu Ge and Wei Yue bowed and approved.

sentences.zh: 或有親舊訊其事端者，韋說曰：「此郭漢子之意也。」

translations.literal: When relatives and friends inquired about the matter, Wei Yue said: "This is that Guo fellow's idea."
translations.idiomatic: When relatives and friends asked about the matter, Wei Yue said, "This was that Guo fellow's idea."

sentences.zh: 及崇韜誅，革說即教門人王松上疏奏論，故有此奏。

translations.literal: When Chongtao was executed, Ge and Yue at once had their student Wang Song submit a memorial discussing it—hence this memorial.
translations.idiomatic: After Chongtao was executed, Ge and Yue had their student Wang Song submit the memorial above, which produced this report.

sentences.zh: 識者非之。

translations.literal: The knowing criticized them.
translations.idiomatic: Men of judgment condemned them.

sentences.zh: 天成四年冬十月丙申，詔曰：「本朝一統之時，除嶺南、黔中去京地遠，三年一降選補使，號為南選外，其餘諸道及京百司諸色選人，每年動及數千，分為三選，尚為繁重。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, winter, of the fourth year of Tiancheng, on bingshen, an edict said: "When this dynasty was unified, apart from Lingnan and Qianzhong, where the capital was far and a selection supplement commissioner was sent once every three years, called Southern Selection, for the rest of the circuits and all categories of candidates in the capital's hundred offices, each year the number routinely reached several thousand, divided into three selections—still burdensome.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the tenth month, winter, of Tiancheng 4, an edict declared: "When the dynasty was unified, apart from distant Lingnan and Qianzhong, where a Southern Selection commissioner came every three years, candidates from the circuits and capital offices numbered thousands each year and were divided among three selection boards—still a heavy burden.

sentences.zh: 近代選人，每年不過數百，何必以一司公事，作三處官方。

translations.literal: In recent times candidates each year do not exceed several hundred—why must one office's public business be made into three separate official establishments?
translations.idiomatic: Today candidates number only a few hundred each year; why should one office's business require three separate boards?

sentences.zh: 況有格條，各依資考，兼又明行敕命，務絕阿私，宜新公共之規，俾慎官常之要。

translations.literal: Moreover there are standard articles, each according to qualification and examination, and edicts are clearly enforced to cut off favoritism; we should renew the public rule and thereby make officials careful of their constant duties.
translations.idiomatic: Statutes already govern qualification and review, and edicts clearly forbid favoritism; a renewed public rule should make officials more careful in their duties.

sentences.zh: 其諸道選人，宜令三銓官員，都在省署子細磨勘，無違礙後，即據格同商量註擬，連署申奏，仍不得踵前於私第註官，如此則人吏易可整齊，公事亦無遲滯。」

translations.literal: For candidates of the circuits, the three selection officials should all carefully examine in the provincial offices; after no impediment, then according to the standards jointly deliberate registration, jointly sign and memorialize, and still must not follow precedent by registering offices at private residences—thus personnel may easily be put in order and public business will not be delayed."
translations.idiomatic: Circuit candidates should be examined together in the capital by all three selection officials; after review, appointments shall be registered jointly according to statute and memorialized together, without repeating the old practice of registering offices at private residences—so that personnel may be kept in order and public business not delayed."

sentences.zh: 長興元年三月，敕：「凡是選人，皆有資考，每至赴調，必驗文書，或不具全，多稱失墜，將明本末，須示規程。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Changxing, an edict: "All candidates for selection have qualifications and examinations; whenever they come for assignment documents must be verified—if not complete, many claim loss; to clarify origin and end, regulations must be shown.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Changxing 1, an edict declared: "All candidates have qualification records that must be verified at assignment; when documents are incomplete many claim loss. To clarify the facts, regulations must be set forth.

sentences.zh: 其判成諸色選人，黃甲下後，將歷任文書告赤連粘，宜令南曹逐縫使印，都於後面粘紙，其前後歷任文書，都計多少紙數，仍具年月日，判成授某官。」

translations.literal: For all categories of candidates who have been judged complete, after the yellow roster is issued, past-office documents and household registers should be joined together; the Southern Bureau should stamp each seam, all paste paper on the back, count how many sheets of past-office documents there are in all, and still list year, month, and day, judged complete and granted such-and-such office."
translations.idiomatic: For candidates whose appointments are finalized, after the yellow roster is issued their service documents and household registers shall be joined and stamped seam by seam by the Southern Bureau, with a backing sheet noting the total number of sheets, dates, and the office granted."

sentences.zh: 蓋懼其或分假於人故也。

translations.literal: This was because they feared documents might be lent out to others.
translations.idiomatic: This was lest the documents be lent to others.

sentences.zh: 其年十月，中書奏：「吏部流內銓諸色選人，先條流試判兩節，並委本官優劣等第申奏。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year, the Secretariat memorialized: "For all categories of candidates in the Ministry of Personnel's Flow-Within Selection, the prior article provided trial judgment in two sections, all entrusted to the original office to report superior or inferior grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year, the Secretariat wrote: "For candidates in the Ministry of Personnel's Flow-Within Selection, the prior rule required two trial judgments, with the original office reporting grades of superior or inferior merit.

sentences.zh: 文優者宜超一資註擬，其次者宜依資，更次者以同類官註擬，所以勵援毫之作，亦不掩歷任之勞。

translations.literal: Those superior in writing should be registered one rank above qualification; the next should follow qualification; the lowest should be registered in offices of the same category—thus to encourage brushwork yet not obscure the labor of past terms.
translations.idiomatic: Those superior in writing should be registered one rank above qualification, the next according to qualification, and the lowest in offices of the same category—encouraging literary effort without obscuring past service.

sentences.zh: 其或於理道全疏者，以人戶少處州縣同類官中比擬，仍準元敕，業文者任征引古今，不業文者但據公理判斷可否。

translations.literal: If wholly deficient in principle and the Way, compare within offices of the same category in prefectures and districts with few households; still follow the original edict—those practiced in letters may cite ancient and modern, those not practiced in letters need only judge by public reason whether it is acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Those wholly deficient in principle may be compared with similar offices in thinly populated districts, still under the original edict: the literate may cite ancient and modern examples, the non-literate need judge only by reason.

sentences.zh: 不當，罪在有司。

translations.literal: If improper, guilt lies with the responsible office.
translations.idiomatic: If the judgment is improper, the responsible office bears guilt.

sentences.zh: 兼諸色選人，或有元通家狀，不實鄉里名號，將來赴選者，並令改正，一一堅本貫屬鄉縣，兼無出身，一奏一除官等，宜並不加選限。」

translations.literal: Moreover for all categories of candidates, if there were originally permissive family statements or untrue local designations, those coming to selection in the future should all be ordered to correct them, each firmly fixing native district and subordinate county; also those without initial credential, one memorial one appointment, and the like should all not have selection limits added."
translations.idiomatic: Candidates with lax family statements or false local designations must correct them and fix their native districts; those without initial credentials or appointed by single memorial should not face added selection limits."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 應順元年閏正月丁卯，中書門下奏：「準天成二年十二月敕，長定格應經學出身人，一任三考，許入下縣令、下州錄事參軍，亦入中下州錄事參軍；

translations.literal: In the intercalary first month of the first year of Yingshun, on dingmao, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "According to the edict of the twelfth month of the second year of Tiancheng, the long-standing rule for those of Classics-learning origin: one term with three evaluations permits entry as magistrate of a lower county or registrar of a lower prefecture, also registrar of a middle-lower prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the intercalary first month of Yingshun 1, the Secretariat wrote: "Under the edict of Tiancheng 2, twelfth month, the standing rule for Classics graduates is: after one term and three evaluations they may become magistrate of a lower county or registrar of a lower or middle-lower prefecture;

sentences.zh: 兩任四考，許入中下縣令、中州錄事參軍；

translations.literal: two terms with four evaluations permit entry as magistrate of a middle-lower county or registrar of a middle prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: after two terms and four evaluations, magistrate of a middle-lower county or registrar of a middle prefecture;

sentences.zh: 兩任六考，許入上縣令及緊州錄事參軍。

translations.literal: two terms with six evaluations permit entry as magistrate of an upper county and registrar of a tight prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: after two terms and six evaluations, magistrate of an upper county or registrar of a key prefecture.

sentences.zh: 凡為進取，皆有因依，或少年便受好官，或暮齒不離卑任。

translations.literal: In all advancement there are grounds and dependencies—some receive good offices while young, some never leave humble posts in old age.
translations.idiomatic: Advancement always depends on circumstance: some receive good offices while young, others never leave humble posts in old age.

sentences.zh: 況孤貧舉士，或年四十，始得經學及第，八年合選，方受一官，在任多不成三考，第二選漸向蹉跎，有一生終不至令錄者，若無改革，何以發揚？

translations.literal: Moreover poor and solitary scholars may be forty before passing the Classics examination; eight years until eligible for selection, then receive one office; in office many do not complete three evaluations, the second selection gradually drifts into delay—some live their whole lives never reaching magistrate or registrar; if there is no reform, how can they be raised up?
translations.idiomatic: Poor scholars may be forty before passing the Classics examination, wait eight years for selection, receive one office, and often fail to complete three evaluations; their second selection drifts into delay, and some never reach magistrate or registrar in a lifetime. Without reform, how can they advance?

sentences.zh: 自此經學出身，請一任兩考，許入中下縣令、下州錄事參軍者。」

translations.literal: From now on for Classics-learning origin, I request that after one term with two evaluations they be permitted entry as magistrate of a middle-lower county or registrar of a lower prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Classics graduates after one term and two evaluations be allowed magistrate of a middle-lower county or registrar of a lower prefecture."

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「參選之徒，艱辛不一，發身遲滯，到老卑低，宜優未達之人，顯示惟新之澤。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Those entering selection have hardships not all alike—starting late, remaining low to old age; the not-yet-advanced should be favored and renewing grace displayed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict replied: "Candidates face varied hardships, starting late and ending low; the not-yet-advanced should be favored and renewing grace displayed.

sentences.zh: 其經學出身，一任兩考，元敕入下縣令、下州錄事參軍，起今後更許入中下縣令、下州錄事參軍；

translations.literal: For those of Classics-learning origin, after one term with two evaluations, the original edict permitted entry as magistrate of a lower county or registrar of a lower prefecture; from now on they are further permitted entry as magistrate of a middle-lower county or registrar of a lower prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: For Classics graduates, after one term and two evaluations, the former edict allowed only magistrate of a lower county or registrar of a lower prefecture; henceforth they may also enter as magistrate of a middle-lower county or registrar of a lower prefecture;

sentences.zh: 一任三考者，於人戶多處州縣註擬，如於近敕條內，資敘無相當者，即準格循資考入官；

translations.literal: those with one term and three evaluations shall be registered in prefectures and districts with many households; if within the recent edict articles no matching qualification is found, then follow the standard and enter office according to qualification and examination;
translations.idiomatic: those with one term and three evaluations shall be registered in populous districts; if no matching post appears under the recent edict, they shall enter office according to the standard qualification ladder;

sentences.zh: 其兩任四考者，準二任五考例入官，餘準格條處分。」

translations.literal: those with two terms and four evaluations follow the precedent of two terms and five evaluations for entering office; the rest follow standard articles for disposition."
translations.idiomatic: those with two terms and four evaluations follow the precedent for two terms and five evaluations; all other cases follow the standard regulations."

sentences.zh: 晉天福三年正月，詔曰：「舉選之流，苦辛備歷，或則耽書歲久，或則守事年深，少有違礙格條，例是不知式樣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Tianfu of Jin, an edict said: "The stream of examination and selection has fully endured hardship—some have devoted themselves to books for many years, some have kept office for many years; rarely violating standard articles, it is usually because they do not know the forms.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tianfu 3 of Jin, an edict declared: "Candidates for examination and selection have endured great hardship—some studying books for years, others holding office for years—and when they rarely violate a regulation, it is usually because they do not know the proper forms.

sentences.zh: 今則方求公器，宜被皇恩，所有選人等，宜令所司，除元駁放及落下事由外，如無違礙，並與施行。

translations.literal: Now we are just seeking public vessels and they should receive imperial grace; all candidates and the like should be ordered by the responsible offices that, apart from matters originally rejected or dropped, if there is no impediment, all should be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the state seeks public talent, they should receive imperial grace; responsible offices should implement all candidates' cases except those originally rejected or dropped, provided there is no impediment.

sentences.zh: 仍令所司遍下諸道，起今後文解差錯，過在發解州府官吏。」

translations.literal: Still order the responsible offices to announce throughout the circuits that from now on errors in literary credentials lie with the officials of the credentialling prefecture or district."
translations.idiomatic: Responsible offices shall also announce to all circuits that from now on errors in literary credentials shall be charged to the credentialling prefectural officials."

sentences.zh: 漢乾祐二年八月，右拾遺高守瓊上言：「仕宦年未三十，請不除授縣令。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Qianyou of Han, Right Remonstrance Councillor Gao Shouqiong submitted: "For office-holders under thirty years of age, I beg that they not be appointed magistrates."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Qianyou 2 of Han, Right Remonstrance Councillor Gao Shouqiong wrote: "I ask that officials under thirty not be appointed magistrates."

sentences.zh: 因下詔曰：「起今後諸色選人，年七十者宜註優散官；

translations.literal: Accordingly an edict was issued: "From now on for all categories of candidates, those seventy years old should be registered for superior scattered offices;
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: "Henceforth, candidates of all categories aged seventy should receive superior scattered offices;

sentences.zh: 年少未歷資考者，不得註授令錄。」

translations.literal: those young in years who have not passed through qualification examinations may not be registered for magistrate or registrar."
translations.idiomatic: those young in years who have not completed qualification reviews may not be registered as magistrates or registrars."

sentences.zh: 其年十二月，中書門下奏：「應諸出選門官並歷任內曾升朝及兩使判官，今任卻授令錄者，並依見任官選數赴集。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "All who have passed through the selection gate and in past service have attended court or served as judges for the two commissions, yet in present office are appointed magistrate or registrar—all should come to assembly according to the selection count of their present office."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of that year, the Secretariat wrote: "Officials who have passed through the selection gate and once attended court or served as commissioners' judges, yet are now appointed magistrate or registrar, shall all assemble according to the selection count of their present office."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 周廣順元年二月，詔曰：「自前朝廷除官，銓司選授，當其用闕，皆稟舊規。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Guangshun of Zhou, an edict said: "From before, when the court appointed offices and the selection office granted appointments, when using vacancies all followed old rules.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangshun 1 of Zhou, an edict declared: "When the court appoints offices and the Selection Office grants posts, vacancies have always been filled according to established rules.

sentences.zh: 近聞所得官人，或他事阻留，或染疾淹駐，始赴任者既過月限，後之官者遂失期程，以至相沿，漸成非次。

translations.literal: Recently it is heard that appointed officials are sometimes detained by other affairs or linger with illness; the first to take office has already passed the monthly limit, and those coming after lose the schedule—so that continuing in succession, it gradually becomes out of order.
translations.idiomatic: Recently appointed officials are often detained by other business or linger with illness; the first incumbent passes the monthly limit while successors miss their schedule, and the practice has gradually fallen out of order.

sentences.zh: 是致新官參謝欲上，舊官考秩未終，待滿替移，動逾時月，雕殘一處，新舊二官，在迎送以為勞，必公私之失緒。

translations.literal: This causes the new official to pay respects and wish to take office while the old official's evaluation rank is not finished, waiting for full replacement and transfer—often exceeding months; one ravaged place has two officials, old and new, occupied with welcoming and sending as labor, surely losing order in public and private affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the new official arrives to pay respects while the old one's evaluation term is unfinished; replacement drags on for months, leaving one distressed district with two officials busy with formalities and both public and private affairs in disorder.

sentences.zh: 今後應諸道州府錄事參軍、判司、縣令、主簿等，宜令本州府，以到任月日，旋具申奏及報吏部，此後中書及銓司，以到任月日用闕，永為定制。」

translations.literal: From now on for registrars, judges, magistrates, chief clerks, and the like in all circuit prefectures and districts, their home prefecture or district should, on the month and day of arrival, promptly memorialize and report to the Ministry of Personnel; thereafter the Secretariat and selection office shall use the month and day of arrival for vacancies—permanently as fixed regulation."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth registrars, judges, magistrates, chief clerks, and the like in all circuits shall have their home prefecture report the date of arrival to the Ministry of Personnel; thereafter the Secretariat and Selection Office shall fill vacancies by that date as a permanent rule."

sentences.zh: 其年十月，詔曰：「選部公事，比置三銓，所有員闕選人，分在三處，每至註擬之際，資敘難得相當。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year, an edict said: "The selection department's public business formerly set up three selection boards; all vacancies and candidates were divided among three places, and whenever registration came, qualifications were hard to match appropriately.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year, an edict declared: "The Selection Department formerly maintained three boards; vacancies and candidates were divided among them, and qualifications were hard to match at registration.

sentences.zh: 況今年選人不多，宜令三銓公事，並為一處，委本司長官通判，同商量可否施行。

translations.literal: Moreover this year's candidates are not many; the three selection boards' business should all be made one place, entrusted to this office's chief for overall judgment, jointly deliberating whether to implement.
translations.idiomatic: This year candidates are few; the three boards' business should be combined in one place under the department chief, who shall deliberate jointly on implementation.

sentences.zh: 今當開泰之期，宜軫單平之眾，自今後合格選人，歷任無違礙者，並仰吏部南曹判成，如文解差錯，不合式樣，罪在發解官吏。」

translations.literal: Now at the season of opening peace, we should sympathize with the solitary and common multitude; from now on qualified candidates with past service free of impediment—all rely on the Ministry of Personnel Southern Bureau for judgment complete; if literary credentials err and do not match the forms, guilt lies with the credentialling officials."
translations.idiomatic: Now in this season of renewed peace, the state should care for the common people; henceforth qualified candidates whose service records are unimpeded shall all be finalized by the Ministry of Personnel Southern Bureau; errors in credentials shall be charged to the credentialling officials."
